sources.title: GigaChat3 10B A1.8B — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact Russian-language specialist with a surprisingly large context window for its size — 262K tokens lets it hold long documents in memory while running on modest hardware. The active parameter count of 1.8B (from a 10B total) suggests a mixture-of-experts design, meaning it routes efficiently rather than firing all neurons at once. Expect solid performance on Russian text tasks, though ...

sources.title: forzer/GigaChat3-10B-A1.8B
sources.snippet: GigaChat3-10B-A1.8B is a dialogue model of the GigaChat family. The model is based on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 10B total and 1.8B active parameters. The architecture includes Multi-head Latent Attention and Multi-Token Prediction.
